title: Mutant's Eye & Cosmic Realms
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large crystal ball in the foreground containing multiple human and alien faces with a central eye. A knight in armor holding a staff and sign numbered 17 stands beside it, with a sign above reading 'LOT 666 - THE MUTANT'S EYE & OTHER RELICS'. The background shows a gothic cathedral-like structure, floating planets including a cracked green world and a red ringed planet, swirling cosmic patterns in purple and green, and various figures including astronauts, robed people, and small alien creatures.
